title: Kindly and Please (2/2)
titleZh: kindly 和 please 的差別（2/2）
summaryZh: 示範 please 在請求句與動詞用法中的實例，並收尾節目。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: And Americans almost always use please when making a request in the form of a statement as opposed to a question.
sentences.zh: 而美國人在用直述句、而不是疑問句提出請求時，幾乎一定會加上 please。

sentences.text: I hope this answer pleases you.
sentences.zh: 希望這個回答能讓你滿意。

sentences.text: There, I used it as a verb.
sentences.zh: 在這句話裡，我把它當成動詞來用。

sentences.text: Kindly visit our website again for more lessons.
sentences.zh: 歡迎再上我們的網站，看看更多課程。

sentences.text: What questions do you have about English?
sentences.zh: 你對英文有什麼問題呢？

sentences.text: Send us an email at learningenglish at voanews.
sentences.zh: 寫電子郵件給我們，地址是 learningenglish 小老鼠 voanews。

sentences.text: com And that's Ask a Teacher for this week.
sentences.zh: com。本週的《問老師》就到這裡。
